verdict.rationale: Trello has the building blocks: an Inbox that captures incoming items from email and Slack, rule-based automation, an MCP server to connect Trello to external AI tools, AI writing assistance, and webhooks and an API. Automatic AI triage and prioritization would still have to be assembled with an external AI agent; the evidence shows no native AI triage feature. Missing for 10: native AI-driven triage/prioritization of incoming bugs and tasks, documentation of an AI triage workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.
